prior_bank.role: Previously completed separate obligation; not a premise for local bridge exclusion.

roster.rank_rule: Lexicographic tuples from range(5)^5 having exactly one nonzero consecutive difference, equal to -1 or +1.
roster.sign_rule: Lexicographic tuples from (-1,0,1)^5 containing at most one zero.
roster.exclusion_rule: Positive integer cost: abs(first)+abs(last)+sum(abs(a-b) on straight edges)-sum(h*(a+b) on diagonal edges).
roster.serialization: UTF-8 json.dumps(all profile dictionaries, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) without final newline.

scope: Conditional local forward-separating chain exclusions only. No global vacancy/sign/graph enumeration, no theorem acceptance.
